full_backend.scope:
Original full Box2D 2.0.1 world/shape/mass/contact/solver instructions versus source-built ARM64.
Only allocation/libc/imported IEEE arithmetic/trig and contact listener observers are fixtures.
 Cases cover circle/polygon mass, dynamic/static/sensor/filter/fixed-rotation/bullet policies, gravity and zero dt, successful/out-of-range SetXForm, zero-mass pin, high-speed velocity limiting and continuous collision. Joint dynamics and arbitrary authored polygon shapes are not exercised.

full_backend_host.optimization: O1, no fast math, fp-contract off
full_backend_host.scope: Complete source physics with real host libc/math, original-derived body/world/contact snapshots; no physics service stubs. Joint dynamics and arbitrary authored polygons not exercised.

native_body.scope:
Actual original PhysicalObject/Stop/pin/unpin and Box2D world instructions
versus the native adapter linked to the genuine Box2D 2.0.1 release. No shape,
proxy, mass, transform, DropPath, policy getter, solver or Step is intercepted.
Allocator/libc/imported IEEE arithmetic and trig are the desktop CPU services.
The public snapshot contains no inferred native private force/sleep-time fields.

physical-world.scope:
Original PhysicalWorld filter/contact/timing instructions vs native ARM64.

Debug-only logging/string/canary blocks are omitted in contact dispatch; the
original instigator function and both virtual calls execute. Collision policies,
velocity getters and contact recipients are supplied observers. Box2D Step is
an argument observer in timing cases; backend simulation has its own audit.

physical-lifecycle.scope:
Original pin/unpin, SetMass and SetMassFromShapes versus native ARM64.

All original mass, center/sweep, fixed-rotation, type and pin/sleep instructions
execute. Shape ComputeMass/UpdateSweepRadius/RefilterProxy are supplied services,
compared in exact order with their current pin/type and argument fields. No
modern mass minimum or velocity correction is substituted. This verifies the
mass/lifecycle bridge, not shape mass geometry, collision or world stepping.

visual-motion.fidelity: Actual original root/applicator/game and visual routines. AbsolutePosition and SetXForm services observed; timeline/animator type/ownership fixtures. Full animator blending, culling and frame scheduling remain external.
